# ESAEM - Escuela Superior de Artes Escénicas de Málaga

> ESAEM is a premier performing arts conservatory in Málaga, Spain offering professional training in drama, dance, musical theater, and vocal performance with world-class facilities and faculty.

ESAEM (Escuela Superior de Artes Escénicas de Málaga) is a high-performance arts school founded on the principles of artistic excellence and talent development. The institution features the Teatro Antonio Banderas, international partnerships, and a strong alumni network of professional performers.

- Performing Arts Education
